name: Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI)
description: A personality inventory classifying individuals into 16 types based on four dichotomies: Extraversion/Introversion, Sensing/Intuition, Thinking/Feeling, Judging/Perceiving.
reputation: World's most widely used personality assessment commercially; 2 million+ taken annually.
notes: Low test-retest reliability; dichotomous types criticized; limited predictive validity; popular despite scientific critiques.
